everyday.source: A reading group has nine people and forty-five minutes on Wednesday. The room is undecided.

versions.text: Nine people will meet; the room is undecided.

everyday.comment: make it twelve people in Room 4 so it sounds complete.
everyday.guidance: The source gives nine people and no room. Keep those facts and ask for an updated source if you need clarification. Complete-looking wording does not establish new facts.

work.source: Noor is the assigned agenda owner; Lee invites participants.

versions.text: Lee is the agenda owner; Lee invites participants.
Noor is the agenda owner; Lee invites participants.

work.guidance: V2 already assigns the agenda to Noor, matching the source. The comment still concerns v1. Recording already addressed does not claim that v2 received a new review.

technical.source: A file form should accept PDFs up to 2 MB. No test has run.
technical.comment: separate the expected rejection from the actual execution status.
technical.guidance: The 2 MB requirement supports expected rejection of a 3 MB PDF. It does not establish a passing execution result: no test has run. Keep expected behavior and actual execution separate.
